title: Learn to Vaccinate: Combining Structure Learning and Effective Vaccination for Epidemic and Outbreak Control
abstract: arXiv:2506.15397v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Susceptible-Infected-Susceptible (SIS) model is a widely used model for the spread of information and infectious diseases, particularly non-immunizing ones, on a graph. Given a highly contagious disease, a natural question is how to best vaccinate individuals to minimize the disease's extinction time. While previous works showed that the problem of optimal vaccination is closely linked to the NP-hard Spectral Radius Minimization (SRM) problem, they assumed that the graph is known, which is often not the case in practice. In this work, we consider the problem of minimizing the extinction time of an outbreak modeled by an SIS model where the graph on which the disease spreads is unknown and only the infection states of the vertices are observed. translated_title: 学会疫苗接种：结合结构学习与有效疫苗接种以实现流行病与疫情控制
translated_abstract: 易感-感染-易感（SIS）模型是一种广泛应用于图上信息与传染病（尤其是非免疫型传染病）传播的模型。面对高传染性疾病，一个自然的问题是如何最优地为个体接种疫苗以最小化疾病的灭绝时间。以往的研究表明，最优疫苗接种问题与NP难的谱半径最小化（SRM）问题密切相关，但这些研究假设图结构是已知的，而这在实践中往往并不成立。在本工作中，我们考虑在SIS模型下最小化疫情爆发灭绝时间的问题，其中疾病传播所在的图结构是未知的，只能观察到顶点的感染状态。为此，我们将该问题分解为两个部分：学习图结构和确定有效的疫苗接种策略。我们提出了一种新颖的基于容斥原理的学习算法，并且与以往……
tldr: 该论文提出在图结构未知、仅能观测节点感染状态的情况下，将基于容斥原理的结构学习算法与有效疫苗接种策略相结合，以最小化SIS模型下疫情的灭绝时间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes combining a novel inclusion-exclusion-based structure learning algorithm with effective vaccination strategies to minimize the extinction time of SIS-modeled epidemics when the underlying graph is unknown and only vertex infection states are observable.
